mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp loads the crossbows as MODEL_BOW + i + 8 from CrossBow{i+1}, so number 14 is CrossBow07.bmd; _enum.h:1583 MODEL_AQUAGOLD_CROSSBOW = MODEL_BOW + 14; OpenMU Version075 Weapons.cs:149.
why_this_one: Drop level 72: Blood Castle 3's monsters (56-79) reach it, and it was one of the three pieces of gear in that window not built (the user, 2026-10-03: 'Build the six missing items ... then the four drops').

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Weapons.cs:149. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: CreateWeapon(group, number, slot, skillNumber, width, height, dropsFromMonsters, name, dropLevel, minimumDamage, maximumDamage, attackSpeed, durability, magicPower, levelRequirement, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, energyRequirement, vitalityRequirement, wizardClass, knightClass, elfClass).
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are the wizard, knight and elf flags.

stance_from: A crossbow by MU's own range test (CharacterManager.cpp:79, MODEL_CROSSBOW to MODEL_AQUAGOLD_CROSSBOW), two-handed as every crossbow here.
fires_note: ZzzEffectMagicSkill.cpp:229: `case MODEL_AQUAGOLD_CROSSBOW: CreateEffect(MODEL_ARROW_BOMB, ...)`. ArrowBomb is not built, so `fires` is left out and the steel bolt flies, as for the Bluewing.
sheet_from: Data/Item/jo00.OZJ (128x64, black horn and plate with gold filigree) and jo01.OZJ (64x32, gold strokes on black, a sheet drawn to be added), from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py; 236 triangles.
glow_note: ItemObjectAttribute (ZzzObject.cpp:5242-5247): `case MODEL_BLUEWING_CROSSBOW: case MODEL_AQUAGOLD_CROSSBOW: BlendMesh = -2; BlendMeshLight = sin(WorldTime*0.004)*0.3 + 0.7`, and a BlendMesh of -2 draws every mesh added (ZzzBMD.cpp:1509) -- the whole Aquagold is a breathing additive ghost, as the Bluewing is. jo01 (gold strokes on black) is a shell coincident with jo00's and clean_lowpoly's weld drops it as duplicate faces, so its glow names no slot and asset.sh says so (2026-10-03); jo00's shell carries the look alone, as the Bluewing's jk00 does.
material_note: No baked material: MU draws both meshes added (see glow_note), so it ships as glow parts on MU's raw sheets; the islands' materials go unused.
rig_note: CrossBow07.rig.json from export-rig --actions=all: one bone, one action of one key, nothing moves (2026-10-03); kept as the Bluewing keeps its own.
